historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes repeated destructive writes but omits the alternating direction, reboot/version oracle and target/image identity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores upgrade/downgrade symmetry and post-cycle GPU/PCIe/host health.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Single upgrade or downgrade cases validate one transition but cannot substitute for 24-hour endurance and every-cycle reboot/readback.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Requires explicit completed-pair and elapsed-time accounting; a high cycle count alone cannot satisfy the full 24-hour window.

original_test_intent: Stress the selected AMD GPU VBIOS update path for 24 hours by alternating approved upgrade and downgrade images, rebooting after each write and proving the intended active version and health every time.
original_method: Pin GPU board/UUID/BDF, flash tool, signed compatible N/N-1 image pair, backup and recovery; obtain dedicated-SUT approval; for each transaction flash one intended image, preserve tool result, reboot via approved method, re-identify target, read active VBIOS and GPU/PCIe/driver/BMC/log health, then alternate direction; stop on first anomaly and require both elapsed 24 hours and only complete successful pairs.
manual_activity: GPU firmware owner approves image pair, target, 24-hour maintenance/wear exposure and validated recovery and owns any failed-cycle disposition and final verdict.
required_inputs: Signed pinned vendor flash utility/hash and command guide
Signed compatible upgrade/downgrade image pair, hashes and expected versions/banks
Stable GPU UUID/BDF/board mapping and recoverable backup
Dedicated 24-hour maintenance approval, stable power/cooling and reboot/reconnect policy
Vendor recovery fixture/path, OOB access, watchdog and protected evidence capacity
safety_requirements: Two-factor verify target and image before every write
One flash then approved reboot/readback at a time; no overlapping operations
Stop on flash, power, thermal, reboot, reconnect, version, GPU/PCIe or log anomaly
Never continue to reach 24 hours or retry automatically after a failed/interrupted write
Preserve failed state and invoke only the approved recovery owner/path
agent_execution_scope: After explicit approval coordinate alternating one-cycle transactions
Capture every reboot/readback/health result and elapsed/pair accounting
Stop-first-error and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve images, compatibility, wear budget, outage and recovery
Authorize destructive 24-hour run and any recovery
Disposition failed/incomplete cycles and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic looping does not bind images, direction, target, reboot or active-version readback.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the approved vendor flash commands for the signed upgrade/downgrade pair, alternating one write at a time; reboot and verify exact active version and health before the next direction.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The upgrade-then-downgrade pair, reboot after every modification, fifteen-minute attendance and 1,440-minute window remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Model each flash as a journaled transaction with pre-state, intended image, tool output, reboot/reconnect, active-version/target rebind and health result; stop atomically at first failure.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines 'always success' as zero failed or incomplete transactions throughout the full elapsed window and proves version activation, not just write exit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful write without reboot/readback, or only one direction, is incomplete coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: This stress consumes flash endurance and can brick hardware; the approved wear budget and recovery hardware determine whether execution is acceptable.

project_override_considerations: Firmware owner defines N/N-1 image pair, bank/activation behavior, reboot type, endurance budget and final desired version; none may be inferred.
expected_evidence: Tool/image signatures, hashes, compatibility and stable GPU/board identity
Backup/recovery validation, explicit approval and stable power/thermal/OOB preflight
Per-cycle direction, image, exact argv, flash output/exit/timestamps
Per-cycle reboot/reconnect, re-identified GPU and expected active VBIOS/version/bank
GPU enumeration, PCIe/driver/BMC/log health and stop-first-error record
Elapsed 24-hour complete-pair summary, final desired state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines alternating upgrade/downgrade with reboot and version confirmation for 24 hours.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Approved images/tool/recovery and maintenance are provisionable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Turns an unsafe generic loop into per-write recoverable transactions with direction, reboot, activation, health and elapsed-time completeness.
independent_technical_reasoning: A flash utility success only shows a write attempt, not that the intended image became active after reset. Reboots can renumber BDFs, so stable board/UUID identity must rebind the target each cycle. Alternating directions stresses both compatibility paths; continuing after any mismatch compounds corruption and destroys the first-failure evidence. Completion therefore requires a full 24-hour elapsed window of complete verified pairs, not a blind loop count.
